body:
Source: GitHub issue #747 (bug, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 16ba5fa8: packages/rejection-mining/lib/llm.mjs:73-85, bin/rejection-mining.mjs:83-90. `refineClusters` catches per-cluster LLM failures, logs to stderr, and returns whatever partial Map it has. When every cluster refinement fails (e.g. invalid or missing API key), `llmRefinements` is empty, and the CLI silently falls back to unrefined lenses and exits 0 with `rejection-mining: done.`. Neither JSON nor human output distinguishes refined from fallback lenses.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/rejection-mining`: `bin/rejection-mining.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/llm.mjs` (refineCluster, refineClusters), `lib/mine.mjs`, `lib/lens.mjs`, `lib/report.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/rejection-mining` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `bin/rejection-mining.mjs`: When `--llm` is specified and `clusters.length > 0`, if all cluster refinements fail (`llmRefinements.size === 0`), call `opError('LLM refinement failed for all clusters. Use --prompt-only to inspect prompts.')` (exit 1) instead of silently proceeding to write or emit fallback lenses.
2. In `lib/report.mjs` and `bin/rejection-mining.mjs`: In `--json` output, include `refined: boolean` per lens indicating whether LLM refinement was applied. In human report, if partial failures occur, report `LLM refinement failed for N of M clusters`.
3. Documentation: update `packages/rejection-mining/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/rejection-mining.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/rejection-mining.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `rejection-mining --llm` exits 1 with operational error when all cluster refinements fail. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/llm-failure-exit.test.mjs`
- AC2 `rejection-mining --json` outputs `refined: true|false` per lens. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/llm-failure-exit.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/rejection-mining`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "refinement failed" packages/rejection-mining/README.md docs/tools/rejection-mining.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/rejection-mining.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #746 (clobbering lens files) or #749 (parseInt on limit).
title: rejection-mining: fail when --llm requested and all cluster refinements fail
